data.one_liner: Date manipulation library providing DateTime extensions and an Interval object.
data.what_it_does: Adds comprehensive extension methods, getters, and static tools to Dart's DateTime class inspired by date-fns. It also includes an Interval object for handling date ranges and time manipulations.
use_when: You need to easily manipulate, format, or compare DateTime objects in Dart.
You want interval calculations and check if dates fall within ranges.
avoid_when: You prefer built-in DateTime methods without extension pollution.
You need advanced custom calendar UI widgets (use package picker instead).
strengths: Very rich set of DateTime extension methods and properties.
Includes convenient Interval class for range operations.
Supports timeago and intl formatting utilities out of the box.
weaknesses: Has breaking changes in recent major versions.
Extends standard types which may cause naming collisions.
data.setup_notes: No special native setup or configuration required.
